evals.prompt: 我的本地 Zotero 有脑肿瘤分割、肺结节、病理 WSI 三个最低层分类。每个分类添加一篇著名论文，必须下载 PDF，并按年份-会议-方法名打标签。
evals.expected_output: The agent checks the live Connector tree, prepares one reviewed manifest row per leaf, downloads real PDFs locally, imports through Connector, and reports tags and any failures.

evals.expected_output: The agent does not write the Zotero database, preserves an auditable category-resolved PDF tree and manifest, and clearly reports that import remains manual.

evals.prompt: 给持续学习分类添加 EWC，PNAS 不在本次 CCF 归属范围内，不要强加 CCF 标签。
